risk_note: RV2 (ledger, plus the one identity wiring line authorised by the orchestrator 2026-10-19 16:1x; ledger-plan D6 A). BR-FUND-13: every user has one balance account created at registration. ledger exports openUserAccount(trx, { appId, userId }): in the caller's transaction and inside a savepoint it creates the USER_BALANCE row in app.ledger_accounts and the zero row in app.account_balances (available 0, frozen 0, version 0, negative_since NULL); idempotent through ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on the existing unique constraints, existing rows and balances untouched; empty appId / userId -> LedgerError INVALID_INPUT before any SQL. The shared ensureUserAccount now builds the balance row with INSERT ... SELECT from ledger_accounts in a second statement (fresh READ COMMITTED snapshot after a concurrent opener). identity/infra/registration-store.ts insertUser calls it once after the users row is in (savepoint released); a uniqueness conflict opens no account; a ledger failure rejects and the registration transaction rolls back. No other identity logic changed. Existing users are backfilled by B2-02h.
